speaker: Ronald A. Rasband
role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
title: Love Like Jesus
summary: Elder Rasband speaks to everyone grieving loved ones who have strayed, teaching that each person must choose Christ for themselves and that only He can change their hearts, so love, not pressure, is the way to reach them. He draws on Lehi's dream, Alma the Younger turned around by his father's prayers, and the prodigal son welcomed home by love. He asks listeners to hand their despair to Jesus Christ, let go of guilt, never give up, put people before problems, seek Him and pray, and trust that "He's got this."

Eternal life means “to gain salvation, the blessings of eternal family, and exaltation, which is ‘the highest state of happiness and glory’ [Guide to the Scriptures, “Exaltation,” Gospel Library]. Through God’s love and grace, all His children will be resurrected after they die and enjoy immortality (see Moroni 7:41). Eternal life goes beyond immortality and includes inheriting the highest degree of the celestial kingdom, continuing in an eternal family, and being like God and living in His presence” (Topics and Questions, “Eternal Life,” Gospel Library).

findings.quote: Miracles are divine acts, manifestations and expressions of God’s limitless power, and an affirmation that He “is the same yesterday, today, and forever” (Moroni 10:19). As I taught in a previous general conference address, “Jesus Christ, who created the seas, can calm them; He who gave sight to the blind can lift our sights to heaven; He who cleansed the lepers can mend our infirmities; He who healed the impotent man can call for us to rise up with ‘Come, follow me’ [Luke 18:22]” (Ronald A. Rasband, “Behold! I Am a God of Miracles,” Liahona, May 2021, 109–10).
findings.ref: Behold! I Am a God of Miracles
findings.note: Elder Rasband quotes his own earlier conference talk on Christ as a God of miracles
